title: feedback-stew-notes-customer-micro-asks-2026-03-09
content:
Purpose
---
Capture a compact, operationally-focused synthesis of recent frontline customer signals (Feb–Mar 2026), surfaced by support, SRE, and account leads. The goal: capture small, high-leverage micro-asks we can triage into quick patches, product UX work, or longer engineering lanes. Notes are intentionally rough — treat as a working inbox.

Topline summary (one-paragraph)
---
Customers are signaling three recurring themes: intermittent p99 latency spikes when cache miss patterns align with long-context queries; surprising cost/overage behavior when embeddings are batched unpredictably by client-side libraries; and unclear model-fallback behavior when a dedicated pool is temporarily out of capacity. There are ~8 small remediation ideas that would materially reduce noise for our top 20 accounts and two candidate product changes that will likely need PM + eng iteration.

Representative vignettes (raw)
---
- "EdgeDocs" (SaaS search customer): reports repeated 500/504s when sending 8–12k token documents; SRE traces show KV-cache misses + tokenization overhead. Wants: clearer guidance and a per-tenant cache-warm option.
- "FinBot" (enterprise finance): observed sudden billing jump after switching from single embedding calls to batched calls via an internal SDK; believes charge model changed. Wants: per-call cost preview and sample math.
- "LocalAI" (self-hosted customer): attempted to pin a quantized variant and observed silent fallback to a float model when GPU memory was constrained — no alert surfaced. Wants: deterministic pin + fallback logs.

Micro-asks (actionable, low-effort)
---
1) Add a lightweight error-class for "KV_CACHE_MISS_CHAIN" at the request level so CS can triage customers by root cause. (owner: Diego, effort: <1d to add tag, instrument across runtime traces)
2) Small doc: "Embedding cost heuristics when batching" — one pager and example calc snippets for SDKs (owner: Priya, effort: 1–2d).
3) Per-tenant cache-warm API (experimental): POST /v1/cache/warm with sample prefix; no SLA but useful for large batch onboarding (owner: SRE/serving-runtime; scope: prototype spike).
4) Make fallback visible: when a pinned model is replaced by a compatible variant, emit a structured event to audit logs + customer console notification (owner: product-hosted-api, effort: 3–5d backend + console).
5) Quick telemetry spike: capture distribution of sequence-lengths for top 50 tenants for past 30 days and surface p50/p95/p99 (owner: observability, effort: 2–3d).
6) Billing FAQ update + sample calculators added to console billing panel for embeddings/batching (owner: finance-and-legal + product, effort: 2d).
7) Rate-limit transparency: expose current fraction of requests subject to per-route throttling in /v1/usage endpoint (owner: infra, effort: 2–4d).
8) Small endpoint: return suggested quantization profile (small table) per model for a given target latency/cost (owner: optimize, effort: spike).

Impact notes (why these first)
---
- Items 1–2 and 6 address high-signal, low-effort customer confusion that generates repeated CS threads (reduces noise).
- Items 3–5 tackle operational stability/observability and will help reduce escalations for customers ingesting long documents or spikes in tail latency.
- Items 4 and 8 are productively aligned with longer roadmap work (model pinning UX, Optimize recommendations) but starting small mitigates immediate churn risk.

Measurement & success criteria
---
- Short-term (30d): reduce repeat CS threads about the same incidents by 40% for flagged accounts; time-to-first-response for cache-related incidents drops by 20%.
- Mid-term (90d): decreased p99 latency incidents for top 20 tenants by 25% (post telemetry/patch), and fewer billing confusion tickets on embeddings (target <5 tickets/month).

Open questions / unknowns
---
- What is the privacy/PII risk of storing warmed prefixes per tenant? (security check needed.)
- Is there an existing internal endpoint we can reuse for per-tenant sequence-length sampling? (tagging for infra/observability)
- Can console notifications be gated to only admin emails to avoid spamming developer teams?

Suggested immediate next steps (this week)
---
- Diego: prototype the KV_CACHE_MISS_CHAIN tag and add to two example traces (deadline: 2026-03-12).
- Priya: draft the embeddings-batching FAQ with examples and share to #cs-billing for review (deadline: 2026-03-11).
- Jon (SRE): run the sequence-length distribution job (top 50 tenants) and post raw numbers into this doc (deadline: 2026-03-13).
- PM sync: schedule short 30-minute review with product-hosted-api + serving-runtime to scope fallback visibility changes (owner: Evelyn, target: 2026-03-10).

Notes to engineering reviewers (fast context)
---
- Runtime traces indicate that long-context p99 spikes often correlate with cold KV cache followed by large inflight batching; a small optimization: warm common prefixes used by chunking pipelines.
- Billing confusion often stems from embedding batch sizes combined with SDK that retries transparently — the UI could show an estimate before running large backfills.

Appendix: quick links and raw threads
---
- Slack thread: #cs-field -> thread "EdgeDocs latency" (link: slack.com/archives/CS/edge-latency-2026)
- Jira tickets: CS-987 (billing embed thread), INFR-1245 (cache telemetry request)
- PR reference: github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/312 (early caching probe)

Bottom line
---
This is a compact working inbox to triage 6–8 low-friction fixes and 2 product-scope changes. Recommend executing quick docs + telemetry spikes first and reconvening in one week to convert 1–2 patches into sprint work.

-- Evelyn (owner)
